summary: The pilot of the lore-research method (2 November 2026). 25 answers confirmed in classic.db, each with a dossier of facts from warcraft.wiki.gg at pinned revisions and from wow-data's own texts, every fact dated before patch 4.0.1. 21 triads written from the dossiers alone (Opus), then fact-checked, cold-solved blind and read by the editor. Four answers have dossiers but no triad: Black Lotus and Mother Smolderweb had no pre-Cataclysm lore to tell, Mageroyal (one children's book) and Arcanite (crafting only) were cut by the editor. The gates found 26 fact problems (3 high), 15 editorial ones and 8 more at review (Thorium's Dark Iron defectors had no pre-Cataclysm source), all fixed. A model solved 20 of 21 from the clue alone, the six clues reworded at review included (it knows lore better than most players). Open: Stalvan Mistmantle is too obscure as clued, Ogre reads as Ogre or Orc, Fel's hint gives it away, and the Deadmines hint is still quest trivia. None of these triads is in editorial.json yet.
